summary: Design SLAs, track vendor performance, and improve supplier reviews. Explore the five-day course and build practical governance skills.
lede: Vendor governance training helps procurement professionals, contract managers, service managers, and operations leaders oversee outsourced service commitments. It covers translating contract obligations into measurable SLA and KPI baselines, validating performance data, and building Excel scorecards. Participants also practise mapping escalation routes, preparing supplier reviews, tracking corrective actions, and assessing vendor service risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set, monitor, or govern outsourced service commitments across procurement, IT, facilities, and business operations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with service contracts, supplier relationships, or SLA reporting is recommended. Basic Excel use supports the scorecard exercises; coding or programming is not required.
